name: Startale
rootCause: transient storage init flag outlives the constructor and lets anyone reinitialize an ERC7579 account and drain it. Lost: 427.551160 USDC drained in this batch tx (32.555561 USDC reproduced across 3 of 23 victim accounts; ~$2,876 USDC+USDT aggregate across 41 known batches)

descriptions.text: transient storage init flag outlives the constructor and lets anyone reinitialize an ERC7579 account and drain it. Lost: 427.551160 USDC drained in this batch tx (32.555561 USDC reproduced across 3 of 23 victim accounts; ~$2,876 USDC+USDT aggregate across 41 known batches)

Startale’s ERC-7579 smart accounts on Ethereum were exploited. The attacker abused a transient-storage initialization flag in initializeAccount that persists for the entire transaction, allowing re-initialization with a malicious bootstrap in the same tx after factory deployment. This enabled draining ~330 pre-funded counterfactual accounts (no signatures or capital required) for a total of ~$2,876. The Soneium network itself was unaffected.

On 2026-09-16, attackers exploited Startale ERC-7579 smart accounts on Ethereum by abusing an initialization flag that reportedly remained valid for an entire transaction. Public incident trackers state that the flaw allowed same-transaction re-initialization of newly deployed counterfactual accounts with attacker-controlled bootstrap logic, leading to the theft of about $2,876 from roughly 330 pre-funded accounts. Publicly available incident descriptions attribute the exploit to improper initialization state handling in Startale ERC-7579 smart accounts on Ethereum.
